title: Wednesday Daily Practice
subtitle: Weekly test /19 and Speaking preparation
theme: Trial Lesson 2 · Busy lives and how things are made
source: DailyPractice_Trial2_Student.pdf / DailyPractice_Trial2_Teacher.pdf (Pre-IELTS Trial Lesson 2, Daily Practice), Wednesday 4/11 (Weekly test /19)
intro: Weekly test /19 has 4 parts (Vocabulary 5, Grammar 5, Reading 4, Writing 5), done in 45 minutes, without notes or a dictionary. Then step 5 prepares for Speaking (15 minutes). In total 5 steps, about 60 minutes. Deadline 23:30 the same day: complete and on time earns 20 Meow; late or half done earns 10 Meow.

steps.title: Section 1 · Vocabulary /5
steps.instructions: Fill in the gaps from the box: bond · commute · nurture · packed · procrastinate · supportive. One word is not used. No notes, no dictionary.

items.label: 1. My ______ to work takes an hour.
2. Do not ______: start your essay now!
3. A good coach can ______ a young player's talent.
4. The bus is ______ with students at 7 a.m.
5. My family is very ______ of my decision to study abroad.

steps.title: Section 2 · Grammar /5
steps.instructions: Questions 1 to 3: put the verbs in the present simple passive. Questions 4 and 5: rewrite the whole sentence, placing the frequency adverb in the correct position.

items.label: 1. Coffee ______ (grow) in the hills of Vietnam.
4. My grandparents call me on Sundays. (always)

fields.answer: My grandparents always call me on Sundays.
accept: My grandparents always call me on Sundays

items.explain: Trạng từ tần suất đứng trước động từ thường.

items.label: 5. She is tired in the morning. (usually)

fields.answer: She is usually tired in the morning.
accept: She is usually tired in the morning

items.explain: Trạng từ tần suất đứng sau động từ to be.

steps.title: Section 3 · Reading /4
steps.instructions: Read the passage and answer with NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS taken from the passage. Passage: In many Vietnamese families, a weekend lunch often includes rice noodles. The noodles are made from rice flour and water. First, the rice is washed and soaked overnight. Then it is ground into a thick paste, which is steamed in thin sheets. The sheets are cut into long strips and served with herbs and fish sauce. Many people buy fresh noodles at the market, but some families still make them at home because they believe homemade noodles taste better.

items.label: 1. What are the noodles made from?
2. How long is the rice soaked?
3. What is the paste steamed into?
4. Why do some families make noodles at home?

steps.title: Section 4 · Writing /5
steps.instructions: Write an introduction and an overview (2 to 3 sentences) for the bread-making process. Notes: 1 flour, water and yeast are mixed · 2 the dough rests for an hour · 3 the dough is baked in an oven · 4 the bread is sold in shops. The teacher will mark it.

open.model: The notes show how bread is made. There are four stages, from mixing the flour, water and yeast to selling the bread in shops.

ai.type: IELTS Writing Task 1 (process): introduction and overview only, weekly test
ai.task: Read the notes about how bread is made. Write an introduction and an overview (2 to 3 sentences). Notes: 1 flour, water and yeast are mixed; 2 the dough rests for an hour; 3 the dough is baked in an oven; 4 the bread is sold in shops.
criteria: introduction is accurate and in the student's own words
overview gives the number of stages (four)
overview names the first and the last stage
at least two correct present simple passives
no details of every stage and no personal opinion

steps.title: Speaking preparation · voice note
steps.instructions: Prepare keywords (not full sentences) for each question using A.R.E. (Answer, Reason, Example) and use at least 2 new words from this week. Then record 1 voice note of about 45 seconds answering all three questions.
lines: 2. Do you prefer to study in the morning or in the evening?
3. How do you relax after a long day?
steps.note: Thầy sẽ nghe và nhận xét A.R.E. và cách dùng từ mới.

send_today: Hoàn thành 5 bước trên web. Bài viết và voice note sẽ được gửi tự động cho thầy khi bấm Nộp bài.
